name: open-social-protocol
description: Open Social Protocol: a Koinos-based, encrypted, frontend-neutral social layer. Monorepo for the protocol (schemas, contracts, SDK), the reference web client, the browser extension, and the replaceable infrastructure (indexer, Mana sponsor).

scripts.build:all: node scripts/build.mjs packages/proto packages/sdk packages/contracts apps/indexer apps/sponsor apps/web apps/extension
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts
scripts.deploy:testnet: npm run build -w packages/proto -w packages/sdk && npm run build -w packages/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/deploy-contracts.ts --network harbinger
scripts.deploy:localnet: npm run build -w packages/proto -w packages/sdk && npm run build -w packages/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/deploy-contracts.ts --network localnet
